name: plataforma-salud-fabi
description: Plataforma web full-stack accesible para salud dirigida a personas mayores - Salta/NOA

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../ml-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend

author: Fabi Health Platform
